Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا مَنْ دَلَعَ لِسَانَ الصَّبَاحِ بِنُطْقِ تَبَلُّجِهِ
Translation: O Allah, Who unfurls the tongue of morning with its brilliant speech

Arabic text: وَسَرَّحَ قِطَعَ اللَّيْلِ الْمُظْلِمِ بِغَيَاهِبِ تَلَجْلُجِهِ
Translation: And sends forth the fragments of dark night with its gloomy veils

Arabic text: وَأَتْقَنَ صُنْعَ الْفَلَكِ الدَّوَّارِ فِيْ مَقَادِيرِ تَبَرُّجِهِ
Translation: And perfects the making of the revolving celestial sphere in the measures of its adornment
And brightens the light of the sun with the radiance of its blazing

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ دَلَّ عَلٰى ذَاتِهِ بِذَاتِهِ
Translation: O You Who proves Your existence through Your own essence
And is above any resemblance to Your creation
And is exalted above any description of Your qualities

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ قَرُبَ مِنْ خَطَرَاتِ الظُّنُونِ
Translation: O You Who is closer than the thoughts of speculation
Yet far beyond the glances of eyes

Arabic text: وَعَلِمَ بِمَا كَانَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَكُونَ
Translation: And knows what was before it came to be

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ أَرْقَدَنِيْ فِيْ مِهَادِ أَمْنِهِ وَأَمَانِهِ
Translation: O You Who placed me to sleep in the cradle of Your security and protection

Arabic text: وَأَيْقَظَنِيْ إِلٰى مَا مَنَحَنِيْ بِهِ مِنْ مِنَنِهِ وَإِحْسَانِهِ
Translation: And awakened me to what You have bestowed upon me from Your favors and kindness

Arabic text: وَكَفَّ أَكُفَّ السُّوءِ عَنِّيْ بِيَدِهِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ
Translation: And kept away from me the hands of evil through Your power and authority

Arabic text: صَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الدَّلِيلِ إِلَيْكَ فِيْ اللَّيْلِ الْأَلْيَلِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon the guide towards You in the darkest night

Arabic text: وَالْمَاسِكِ مِنْ أَسْبَابِكَ بِحَبْلِ الشَّرَفِ الْأَطْوَلِ
Translation: And the one who holds fast to Your means with the rope of the highest honor

Arabic text: وَالنَّاصِعِ الْحَسَبِ فِيْ ذِرْوَةِ الْكَاهِلِ الْأَعْبَلِ
Translation: And the one of pure lineage in the highest summit of nobility

Arabic text: وَالثَّابِتِ الْقَدَمِ عَلٰى زَحَالِيفِهَا فِيْ الزَّمَنِ الْأَوَّلِ
Translation: And the one of firm foothold on its slippery places in the earliest times
And upon his righteous, chosen, and pious family
O Allah, open for us the gates of morning
With the keys of mercy and success

Arabic text: وَأَلْبِسْنِيْ اللَّهُمَّ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ خِلَعِ الْهِدَايَةِ وَالصَّلَاحِ
Translation: O Allah, clothe me with the best robes of guidance and righteousness

Arabic text: وَأَغْرِسِ اللَّهُمَّ بِعَظَمَتِكَ فِيْ شِرْبِ جَنَانِيْ يَنَابِيعَ الْخُشُوعِ
Translation: O Allah, plant in the core of my heart, by Your greatness, the springs of humility

Arabic text: وَأَجْرِ اللَّهُمَّ لِهَيْبَتِكَ مِنْ آمَاقِيْ زَفَرَاتِ الدُّمُوعِ
Translation: O Allah, cause tears to flow from my eyes out of awe for You

Arabic text: وَأَدِّبِ اللَّهُمَّ نَزَقَ الْخُرْقِ مِنِّي بِأَزِمَّةِ الْقُنُوعِ
Translation: O Allah, discipline my reckless foolishness with the reins of contentment

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ إِنْ لَمْ تَبْتَدِئْنِيْ الرَّحْمَةُ مِنْكَ بِحُسْنِ التَّوْفِيقِ
Translation: My God, if You do not begin with mercy from You by granting good guidance

Arabic text: فَمَنِ السَّالِكُ بِىْ إِلَيْكَ فِيْ وَاضِحِ الطَّرِيقِ
Translation: Then who will lead me to You on the clear path?

Arabic text: وَإِنْ أَسْلَمَتْنِيْ أَنَاتُكَ لِقَائِدِ الْأَمَلِ وَالْمُنَىٰ
Translation: And if Your patience leaves me to the leader of hope and desire

Arabic text: فَمَنِ الْمُقِيلُ عَثَرَاتِيْ مِنْ كَبَوَاتِ الْهَوٰى
Translation: Then who will help me up from the stumbles of passion?

Arabic text: وَإِنْ خَذَلَنِيْ نَصْرُكَ عِنْدَ مُحَارَبَةِ النَّفْسِ وَالشَّيْطَانِ
Translation: And if Your help abandons me in the battle against the self and Satan

Arabic text: فَقَدْ وَكَلَنِيْ خِذْلاَنُكَ إِلٰى حَيْثُ النَّصَبِ وَالْحِرْمَانِ
Translation: Then Your abandonment has left me to fatigue and deprivation

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ أَتَرَانِيْ مَا أَتَيْتُكَ إِلَّا مِنْ حَيْثُ الْآمَالِ
Translation: My God, do You see that I have come to You only through the gate of hope?

Arabic text: أَمْ عَلِقْتُ بِأَطْرَافِ حِبَالِكَ إِلَّا حِيْنَ بَاعَدَتْنِيْ ذُنُوبِىْ عَنْ دَارِ الْوِصَالِ
Translation: Or have I clung to the ends of Your ropes only when my sins have distanced me from the house of union?

Arabic text: فَبِئْسَ الْمَطِيَّةُ الَّتِيْ امْتَطَتْ نَفْسِيْ مِنْ هَوَاهَا
Translation: How wretched is the mount that my soul has ridden in its desires!

Arabic text: فَوَاهًا لَهَا لِمَا سَوَّلَتْ لَهَا ظُنُونُهَا وَمُنَاهَا
Translation: Woe to it for what its thoughts and wishes have enticed it to do!

Arabic text: وَتَبًّا لَهَا لِجُرْأَتِهَا عَلٰى سَيِّدِهَا وَمَوْلاَهَا
Translation: And destruction to it for its boldness against its Master and Lord!

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ قَرَعْتُ بَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ بِيَدِ رَجَائِي
Translation: My God, I have knocked at the door of Your mercy with the hand of my hope

Arabic text: وَهَرَبْتُ إِلَيْكَ لَاٰجِئًا مِنْ فَرْطِ أَهْوَائِي
Translation: And I have fled to You, seeking refuge from the excess of my desires
And I have attached the fingers of my loyalty to the ends of Your ropes

Arabic text: فَاصْفَحِ اللَّهُمَّ عَمَّا كُنْتُ أَجْرَمْتُهُ مِنْ زَلَلِيْ وَخَطَائِي
Translation: So, O Allah, pardon what I have committed of errors and mistakes
And lift me from the fall of my disgrace
For You are my Master, my Lord, my Support, and my Hope

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ غَايَةُ مَطْلُوبِىْ وَمُنَايَ فِيْ مُنْقَلَبِىْ وَمَثْوَايَ
Translation: And You are the Ultimate Goal of my quest and desire in my return and my resting place

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ كَيْفَ تَطْرُدُ مِسْكِينًا الْتَجَأَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الذُّنُوْبِ هَارِبًا
Translation: My God, how could You reject a poor one who has fled to You from sins?

Arabic text: أَمْ كَيْفَ تُخَيِّبُ مُسْتَرْشِدًا قَصَدَ إِلٰى جَنَابِكَ سَاعِيًا
Translation: Or how could You disappoint one seeking guidance who has hastened to Your threshold?

Arabic text: أَمْ كَيْفَ تَرُدُّ ظَمْآنًا وَرَدَ إِلٰى حِيَاضِكَ شَارِبًا
Translation: Or how could You turn away a thirsty one who has come to Your fountains to drink?

Arabic text: كَلَّا وَحِيَاضُكَ مُتْرَعَةٌ فِيْ ضَنْكِ الْمُحُوْلِ
Translation: Never! For Your fountains are full even in times of drought
And Your door is open for seeking and entering
And You are the Ultimate Goal of all requests and the Final End of all hopes

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ هَذِهِ أَزِمَّةُ نَفْسِيْ عَقَلْتُهَا بِعِقَالِ مَشِيَّتِكَ
Translation: My God, here are the reins of my soul which I have bound with the halter of Your will

Arabic text: وَهٰذِهِ أَعْبَاءُ ذُنُوبِىْ دَرَأْتُهَا بِعَفْوِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And here are the burdens of my sins which I have warded off with Your pardon and mercy

Arabic text: وَهٰذِهِ أَهْوَائِيَ الْمُضِلَّةُ وَكَلْتُهَا إِلٰى جَنَابِ لُطْفِكَ وَرَأْفَتِكَ
Translation: And here are my misleading desires which I have entrusted to the threshold of Your kindness and compassion

Arabic text: فَاجْعَلِ اللَّهُمَّ صَبَاحِيْ هٰذَا نَازِلًا عَلَيَّ بِضِيَاءِ الْهُدىٰ
Translation: O Allah, make this morning of mine descend upon me with the light of guidance
And with safety in religion and worldly life
And make my evening a shield from the plots of enemies
And a protection from the destructive passions
Surely You have power over what You will
You give sovereignty to whom You will
And You take away sovereignty from whom You will
You exalt whom You will
And You abase whom You will
In Your hand is all good
Indeed, You have power over all things
You cause the night to enter into the day
And You cause the day to enter into the night
And You bring forth the living from the dead
And You bring forth the dead from the living
And You give provision to whom You will without account
There is no god but You
Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You

Arabic text: مَنْ ذَا يَعْرِفُ قَدْرَكَ فَلَا يَخَافُكَ
Translation: Who is there that knows Your worth and does not fear You?

Arabic text: وَمَنْ ذَا يَعْلَمُ مَا أَنْتَ فَلَا يَهَابُكَ
Translation: And who is there that knows what You are and does not stand in awe of You?
You have united the diverse factions by Your power
And You have split the dawn with Your subtlety
And You have illuminated the darkness of twilight with Your generosity

Arabic text: وَأَنْهَرْتَ الْمِيَاهَ مِنَ الصُّمِّ الصَّيَاخِيدِ عَذْبًا وَأُجَاجًا
Translation: And You have made waters flow from solid rocks, both sweet and bitter
And You have sent down from rain clouds abundant water

Arabic text: وَجَعَلْتَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لِلْبَرِيَّةِ سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا
Translation: And You have made the sun and moon a blazing lamp for creation

Arabic text: مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ تُمَارِسَ فِيْمَا ابْتَدَأْتَ بِهِ لُغُوبًا وَلَا عِلاجًا
Translation: Without experiencing any fatigue or difficulty in what You initiated
O You Who is unique in glory and permanence
And Who has subjected His servants to death and annihilation

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ الْأَتْقِيَاءِ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and his pious family
And hear my call and answer my prayer
And fulfill, by Your grace, my hope and expectation

Arabic text: يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ دُعِيَ لِكَشْفِ الضُّرِّ
Translation: O Best of those who are called to remove harm
And the One hoped for in every difficulty and ease

Arabic text: بِكَ أَنْزَلْتُ حَاجَتِيْ فَلَا تَرُدَّنِيْ مِنْ سَنِيِّ مَوَاهِبِكَ خَائِبًا
Translation: To You I have brought my need, so do not turn me away disappointed from Your lofty gifts

Arabic text: يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ
Translation: O Generous, O Generous, O Generous
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful
And may Allah bless the best of His creation
Muhammad and all his family
My God, my heart is veiled
And my soul is flawed
And my intellect is overcome
And my desires are dominant
And my obedience is little
And my disobedience is much
And my tongue confesses to sins
So what is my solution?
O Concealer of faults
O Knower of the unseen
O Remover of afflictions

Arabic text: اِغْفِرْ ذُنُوبِىْ كُلَّهَا بِحُرْمَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Forgive all my sins by the sanctity of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: يَا غَفَّارُ يَا غَفَّارُ يَا غَفَّارُ
Translation: O All-Forgiving, O All-Forgiving, O All-Forgiving
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful
